decision_conditions: The submitted SuDS Verification Report, in the absence of adequate information regarding the finished levels of the rain gardens and associated rainwater pipes (RWPs), together with insufficient evidence demonstrating the implementation of the approved source control SuDS measures serving the north block, has failed to demonstrate that the approved drainage strategy has been implemented in accordance with Condition 39. In the absence of this information, the Local Planning Authority is unable to verify compliance with the approved drainage strategy. Consequently, the Local Planning Authority cannot be satisfied that the development achieves the sustainable management of surface water, minimises flood risk, minimises the discharge of surface water from the site and will ensure the long-term operation of the approved drainage system. The proposal is therefore contrary to Section 14 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policies SI.12 and SI.13 of the London Plan (2024), Policy CP28 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and Policies DMD59, DMD60, DMD61 and DMD62 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
